candidate: GameInstance Constitution / Encounter Assembly / Participation Lifecycle

candidateDeletion.reason: One session may contain multiple GameInstances and one GameInstance may span multiple sessions.
Implementation/UI mechanism absent from many valid GameForms.
Useful local source/view in team and institutional games but absent or dynamic in other GameForms.
One composition mechanism among manual selection, pairing, seating, persistent entry and self-assembly.
A constituted game can start or remain current while an assigned participant is absent.
Substitution/departure can change membership while the same GameInstance continues.
GameInstance can survive interruption/process boundaries and server session can survive membership changes.
Restart/new-game rules can preserve participants/material while explicitly ending the old GameInstance.

probes.foundationResidual: Instance constitution cannot be reconstructed from present actors only.
Instance constitution must consume the admitted participation basis without turning eligibility into membership by identity.
Need owner-local same-instance consequence of composition transition.
No universal threshold survives, but constitution-to-continuation relation does.

probes.pressure: one player leaves while game continues
probes.foundationResidual: Membership transition may restructure current Game state while preserving instance identity.
Instance lifecycle can contain participant-local terminal transitions before instance-global terminality.

probes.pressure: interruption then resumption from preserved position/time
probes.foundationResidual: Game-local continuity depends on preserved constitutive state and authority, not continuous execution.

probes.result: IntendedContinuation != SameGameInstance when constitutive state cannot be restored

probes.pressure: old game ends; same remaining players begin new game while some material can carry over
probes.foundationResidual: Game owner must distinguish same-instance continuation from new-instance creation.

probes.pressure: backfill joins after start and replacements after players leave
probes.foundationResidual: Game must define semantic meaning of late admission and inherited state/history.

probes.pressure: bot/Human composition varies under same broad mode
probes.foundationResidual: C1 tracks admitted composition only when it matters to the concrete instance.

probes.pressure: same semantic role realized by different occupant/substrate
probes.foundationResidual: Instance continuity must consume explicit practice semantics rather than infer from substrate identity.

obligations.name: ConstitutionBasisAndCurrentness
obligations.question: Which GameStructure/practice/configuration, constitutive state and participation/admission bases currently bind this concrete GameInstance, under what authority/currentness?

obligations.name: ParticipationCompositionAndTransition
obligations.question: Who/what is currently admitted/bound and in which current role/team/seat/control relations, and which transition changed that composition?

obligations.name: InstanceContinuityBoundary
obligations.question: Does a relevant change preserve this GameInstance, terminate/abandon/annul it, or create/restart a new GameInstance, and on what authority/provenance?
